data.name: Aklimah
data.gender_notes: Aklimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A peaceful soul who finds calmness in the midst of chaos. The name Aklimah carries the meaning “Calm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aklimah usually hope their child will grow to embody calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritually enlightened individual who is at peace with herself and her surroundings
data.etymology: Aklimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aklimah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أكليمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الاسم أكل- إختصار لمركب (علم- إعلم) في العربية، وذو معني بالمعرفة، والتواصل، والمودة، والرحمة، والاستقامة، يرمز للشخص المثقف، والمحفز، والمخلص، والمستدام، والمواظب، ويستخدم في اللغة العربية للوصف، والأسماء الشخصية

in_urdu.name: اکلمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام اکلمہ کا ماخذ عربی زبان کے لفظ علم سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے علم، توثیق، مودت، رحم، استقامت، اکلمہ نے اپنی تعلیمات کے ذریعے مسلمانوں کو علم اور مودت کے راستے پر لایا، اس نام کا استعمال اپنے بچوں کے لیے کرنے والے والدین کا ایک بہترین خیال ہوگا

in_hindi.name: अक्लिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अक्लिमा का अर्थ है ज्ञान, सहमति, प्रेम, दया, निश्चितता, यह नाम एक मुस्लिम लड़के के लिए उपयुक्त है जो शिक्षित, अनुशासनप्रिय, दयालु, और निश्चित होता है, अक्लिमा नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत आम है

in_pashto.name: اکلیمې
in_pashto.long_meaning: اکلیمې نوم د پوهنه، وینا، وړتیا، مهربانی، ټینګار څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا نوم د یو مومن بچي لپاره پوهنه، وینا، وړتیا، مهربانی، ټینګار لرونکی په معنا راځي، اکلیمې نوم په افغانستان کې د مسلمو لوکي لپاره د مسلي نومونو په ډله کې راځي

in_english.name: Aklimah
in_english.meaning: knowledge, verification, love, mercy, stability, and understanding
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aklimah is derived from the Arabic root 'ilm, which means knowledge, verification, love, mercy, stability, and understanding. This name is suitable for a Muslim child who is knowledgeable, verifies information, is loving, merciful, stable, and understanding. Aklimah name has a rich history in Islamic tradition and is widely used in various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aklimah has no direct cultural relevance as it is a made-up name and does not hold any particular cultural significance in the Islamic world or beyond. However, the name signifies a deep yearning for tranquility, peace, and calmness that is highly valued in Islamic culture. Aklimah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of maintaining inner peace and composure in challenging times.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the soul is considered an essential part of a human being, and maintaining its purity and peace is of great significance. The name Aklimah signifies a soul that is at peace, undisturbed by the trials and tribulations of life. It is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards finding inner peace and harmony with one's Creator. Aklimah can be seen as an aspiration for all believers to strive towards, embodying the virtues of patience, resilience, and contentment in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Calm" symbolizes A peaceful soul who finds calmness in the midst of chaos. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aklimah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of calm.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aklimah bint Abdullah ibn Masud was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aklimah carried significant weight in that era.
